name_note: GTDB g__Desulfovibrio corresponds to the classical genus Desulfovibrio, which contains nearly all genomes placed here.

sentences.text: Desulfovibrio are sulfate-reducing bacteria, a group described as a source of sulfide in sulfide-producing hydrothermal vent environments.
Members of the genus carry out hydrogen metabolism: structures of a Ni-Fe hydrogenase from D. gigas and an Fe-only hydrogenase from D. desulfuricans have been solved.
Desulfovibrio species have been reported at significantly higher numbers in stools of severely autistic children than in controls.
A systematic review of the gut microbiota described anxiety and depressive disorders as possibly characterised by higher abundance of proinflammatory species including Desulfovibrio.
